glassCloth.name: Diamond Glass & Mirror Cleaning Cloth
glassCloth.short: Experience a clearer finish with premium microfiber designed for effective glass and mirror cleaning.
glassCloth.detail: Designed to clean glass and mirrors efficiently, this microfiber cloth helps remove dirt and everyday marks while delivering a clean, streak-free finish.

windowSqueegee.name: Compact Window Squeegee
windowSqueegee.short: A practical window cleaning tool with a flexible rubber blade and comfortable handle.
windowSqueegee.detail: Designed for convenient glass and window cleaning, featuring a flexible blade that helps remove water and surface residue efficiently.

floorSqueegee.name: Professional Double-Blade Floor Squeegee
floorSqueegee.short: A practical floor-cleaning solution designed for effective water removal.
floorSqueegee.detail: The double-blade design helps collect and remove water from smooth floor surfaces, making everyday cleaning easier and more efficient.

floorMop.name: Professional 360° Floor Mop
floorMop.short: A versatile floor-cleaning tool with a full-rotation joint and washable microfiber refill.
floorMop.detail: Designed for convenient floor cleaning, its rotating joint improves maneuverability while the washable microfiber refill supports repeated everyday use.

brushesBrooms.name: Reinforced Cleaning Brushes & Brooms
brushesBrooms.short: Durable cleaning brushes designed for different surfaces and everyday cleaning tasks.
brushesBrooms.detail: A practical range of cleaning brushes designed for different cleaning requirements, with soft and hard bristle options.
brushesBrooms.highlight: The right brush for every task.

wasteBags.name: DIAMOND Heavy-Duty Waste Bags
wasteBags.short: Durable waste bags designed for practical everyday waste collection.
wasteBags.detail: Designed for convenient waste collection, DIAMOND waste bags offer a practical combination of durability, capacity options, and everyday reliability.

glassLab.stepsTitle: Three steps to a clearer surface.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.description: Remove loose dust and debris from the glass before you begin.

steps.title: Clean
steps.description: Work in sections with the microfiber cloth and water, then draw the squeegee blade across the surface.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Wipe the blade and frame dry for a clean, even result without marks.

about.title: About DIAMOND
about.subtitle: Cleanliness you can trust.
story: DIAMOND is a premier brand specializing in the supply and distribution of modern household cleaning tools and essential daily utilities. Built on a commitment to uncompromising quality and international standards, we bring efficiency, durability, and convenience directly into modern homes.

Our core mission is to provide innovative and practical household essentials—ranging from advanced cleaning tools to high-quality plastic utilities—designed to meet the highest market standards and earn the lasting trust of our customers.
